correctness.rationale: The model is specified by an explicit Brownian time change. Exponential Brownian exit tails give all necessary regenerative moments. The source Green kernel yields the known cycle length and occupation mean. The centered Poisson potential is solved with valid Dirichlet and interface conditions and vanishes at the restart state. Itô isometry reduces the exact cycle reward second moment to three finite positive power integrals; symbolic simplification proves its closed form for all real alpha>=0 and 0<rho<1. Renewal-reward CLT yields the displayed variance. The exact rational and noninteger numerical tests corroborate intermediate algebra but are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The 2026 motivating paper computes only the threshold-reset stationary occupation fraction and predicts square-root fluctuation order; the exact variance calibrates finite-time uncertainty in this natural observable. The universal centered excursion second-moment factor 1-rho^2, Brownian restart-location invariance, and strict monotonicity for every sluggish alpha>0 provide structural information for the whole natural continuum parameter family, not a routine selected numerical instance. Independent audits remain unperformed.
